segments.name: online grocery
segments.description: Runs an online grocery marketplace connecting shoppers, retailers and brands.
segments.evidence: As such, the Company has one operating and reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Retailers pay for marketplace orders, brands pay for advertising and shoppers earn fees for deliveries.
revenueModel.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, we provide discovery and attractive return on investment for over 9,000 active brands through our industry-leading advertising tools and insights purpose-built for the online grocery category.
